summary: Re-verified the LOW-priority polish fix flagged in iteration_10: dropdown label hydration from localStorage['red5_rh_preset']. All 4 requested scenarios PASS via Playwright on the production preview URL. The useEffect at setup_walk_mockup.html L224-242 now correctly reads both red5_sweet_spot_range AND red5_rh_preset, validates the preset id against RH_PRESETS, and hydrates cfg.rhPreset so the dropdown label, note line, and slider labels are all consistent across reloads.
critical_code_review_comments: setup_walk_mockup.html is now 953 lines (was 944) and still uses cdn.tailwindcss.com + in-browser Babel — console emits the two standard 'not for production' warnings on every load. Acceptable for a preview mockup; precompile before shipping.

RH_PRESETS validation in the new hydration code (`RH_PRESETS.find(x => x.id === preset)`) correctly guards against stale/invalid preset ids in localStorage, so the dropdown can never end up in an undefined state. Good defensive coding.

The persistAndSave handler still doesn't broadcast the preset id through the 'r5-rh-band-change' CustomEvent (only lo/hi). If a future dashboard tile wants to show the venue name live (e.g. 'Museum mode active'), it will need either an extra event field or a 'storage' listener. Not a regression — note only.
seed_data_creation: Test sets/clears localStorage['red5_sweet_spot_range'] and localStorage['red5_rh_preset'] between scenarios via page.evaluate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 scenarios from the review request PASS end-to-end on https://controller-dashboard-2.preview.emergentagent.com/setup_walk_mockup.html. Scenario results: (1) MUSEUM HYDRATION — after clear→pick museum→Save→reload→re-enter, dropdown value='museum', visible text='Museum  ·  40-55% RH', note='AAM collection preservation', sliders=40%/55%. PASS. (2) REGRESSION 10 PRESETS — all of office/museum/hotel/library/hospital/lecture/concert/meeting/exhibition/custom stick on pick with matching slider labels. PASS. (3) MANUAL OVERRIDE — pick museum then drag lo→35 switches dropdown to 'Custom (manual)' with sliders 35/55; save+reload re-opens as 'Custom (manual)' with sliders 35/55 and localStorage red5_rh_preset='custom'. PASS. (4) EMPTY LOCALSTORAGE FALLBACK — after clear+reload, dropdown defaults to 'Office  ·  30-60% RH', sliders 30/60, no JS errors. PASS. Note for next iteration: when scripting React-controlled range sliders, use the native setter trick `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el, '35')` before dispatching input/change events — a plain `el.value = '35'` does NOT fire React's onChange, which initially made TEST 3 appear to fail. After applying the setter trick, TEST 3 passed cleanly.
rca of the issue: Original cosmetic gap was that the useEffect on line ~224 only hydrated cfg.rhLo / cfg.rhHi from localStorage['red5_sweet_spot_range'] but skipped cfg.rhPreset, so the dropdown always reverted to its default 'office' even when the saved range matched a non-office preset. Fix applied by main agent in this iteration: added `const preset = localStorage.getItem('red5_rh_preset'); if (preset && RH_PRESETS.find(x => x.id === preset)) patch.rhPreset = preset;` inside the existing useEffect, and merged via the existing `setCfg(c => ({...c, ...patch}))` call. The RH_PRESETS.find guard rejects unknown/stale ids. Verified working for both built-in preset ids (museum) and the 'custom' id.
